topic: Adding frame tags filter to traffic page
summary_markdown:
A new requirement was discussed for Task 1812: adding a filter based on frame tags to the traffic page. The front end will pull all available tags from inventory and implement a multi-select filter, passing them as an additional parameter (e.g., `&tags=aaa,bbb,ccc`) to the `/api/dashboard/traffic/totals` endpoint and similar methods.

Regarding implementation time, it was estimated that the backend work would take a couple of hours, including adding tags to the directory structure.

The target deployment timeline for the beta environment is set for Tuesday evening.
decisions: The traffic page will receive a new filter based on frame tags.
The backend parameter handling for frame tags must be implemented in API endpoints like /api/dashboard/traffic/totals.
action_items: Implement the server-side logic to accept and calculate metrics based on frame tags (Task 1812).
Deploy the feature to beta environment by Tuesday evening.
